modelDescription: The Rossi RS22 is a reliable and accurate semi-automatic rimfire rifle with blowback action. The textured synthetic Monte Carlo stock is perfectly mated to an 18 free-float barrel for outstanding balance and feel. Offered in .22 LR the RS22 features fully adjustable fiber optic sights, 10 round detachable magazine, and the receiver has a 3/8 dovetail to accept scope mounts. Overall length 36.25 and unloaded weight 4 pounds.
